meta.title: commercetools Customer Case Studies
meta.subtitle: Proven commercetools outcomes across food service, pet care, coffee, building products, steel, pharma and print commerce
meta.intro: A portfolio of Royal Cyber engagements delivered on commercetools — spanning D2C and B2B composable commerce, multibrand platforms, customer service, and regulated marketplaces. Each case maps the client's challenge to the solution delivered and the features that power it.

cases.name: Rich's USA
cases.headline: Scalable, Efficient, and Customer-Centric Commerce

keyFeatures.title: Composable Architecture (D2C Model)
keyFeatures.body: Enabled Rich's to break free from monolithic constraints, scaling rapidly across products, regions, and business units.

keyFeatures.title: Faster Time-to-Market
keyFeatures.body: Reduced deployment cycles for new features and offerings, enabling quicker adaptation to market demands.

keyFeatures.title: Corporate Gifting (B2B Model)
keyFeatures.body: Built a self-service portal where customers can manage gifting orders and receive updates.

keyFeatures.title: Streamlined PIM
keyFeatures.body: Centralized product data into a unified platform, reducing duplication and ensuring consistency across channels.

cases.website: Rich's USA | Foodservice & In-Store Bakery Food Supplier

cases.name: Mars
cases.headline: Personalization, Multibrand Management & Catalog Optimization

keyFeatures.title: Enhanced Personalization
keyFeatures.body: Integrated capabilities for customizable products, such as personalized M&M's, improving engagement and satisfaction.

keyFeatures.title: Streamlined Catalog Management
keyFeatures.body: Efficient management of product catalogs, enabling quicker updates and consistency across channels.

keyFeatures.title: Multibrand Enablement
keyFeatures.body: Centralized management of multiple Mars brands on one platform, preserving brand identity while accelerating time-to-market.

cases.website: Global Petcare, Food & Nutrition, and Snacking Brands | Mars, Incorporated

cases.name: Breville
cases.headline: API-Driven Bundles, Subscriptions & Personalization

keyFeatures.title: Product Bundling & Subscriptions
keyFeatures.body: Flexible bundling and subscription options, combining one-time purchases with recurring subscriptions in a single checkout.

keyFeatures.title: Cross-Brand Promotions
keyFeatures.body: Integrated Voucherify with commercetools via API extensions to manage complex, cross-brand promotional campaigns.

keyFeatures.title: Personalized Experiences
keyFeatures.body: Features like the "coffee quiz" on Beanz.com deliver tailored product recommendations based on taste profiles.

cases.website: Breville Commercial – beanz.com | Coffee Subscription & Delivery

cases.name: GWA
cases.headline: Unified, Intelligent, and Merchant-Driven Digital Experience

keyFeatures.title: Self-Service Merchant Portal
keyFeatures.body: Centralized B2B platform for merchants to manage orders, access pricing, and track inventory without sales reps.

keyFeatures.title: Composable Multi-Brand CMS
keyFeatures.body: Unified content system for managing multiple brand sites, preserving identities and reducing time-to-market.

keyFeatures.title: Dynamic Price Toggling
keyFeatures.body: Real-time switching between customer-specific, tiered, and promotional pricing based on user type and status.

cases.website: Caroma Made For Life AU / Caroma Specify Australia

cases.name: JSW One
cases.headline: Modern Commerce Solutions by Royal Cyber

keyFeatures.title: Configurable Product Variants
keyFeatures.body: Enabled management of complex steel product configurations by weight, grade, and length.

keyFeatures.title: Dynamic Pricing Models
keyFeatures.body: Flexible pricing strategies tailored to customer segments and order volumes.

keyFeatures.title: Omnichannel B2B/B2B2C + AI
keyFeatures.body: Unified marketplace for distributors and retailers, with AI/ML-driven personalized recommendations.

cases.website: Buy Steel Online | Industrial Materials Marketplace | JSW One MSME

cases.name: Wild Fork
cases.headline: CSA-Enabled Seamless Support

keyFeatures.title: Assisted Service Capability
keyFeatures.body: CS agents securely log in as customers for real-time help with purchases, login issues, or cart abandonment.

keyFeatures.title: Integrated Ticketing
keyFeatures.body: Seamless multichannel support (email, chat, phone) with efficient tracking and resolution under unique IDs.

keyFeatures.title: Fraudulent Order Detection
keyFeatures.body: Smart fraud detection using behavioral analytics cut fraud by 50% in three months and boosted efficiency.

cases.website: Meat Online Store | Frozen Meat & Seafood Delivery | Wild Fork Foods

cases.name: Dr. Reddy's
cases.headline: Intelligent, Regulated, and Multi-Vendor Pharma Marketplace

keyFeatures.title: Pharma Marketplace Enablement
keyFeatures.body: Multi-vendor marketplace with RFQs, dynamic pricing, and order workflows across 10,000+ SKUs.

keyFeatures.title: Dynamic Compliance Engine
keyFeatures.body: Regulatory alerts and patent expiration tracking ensure compliance and sourcing restrictions across global markets.

keyFeatures.title: Composable, Region-Aware
keyFeatures.body: commercetools' headless framework supports multi-region deployment (US, EU, India) with role-based buyer access.

cases.website: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories – Good Health Can't Wait

cases.name: Dragon Shield
cases.headline: Secure, Scalable, and Seamlessly Personalized Commerce

keyFeatures.title: Custom CSR Moderation
keyFeatures.body: A commercetools Custom Application in the Merchant Center lets CSRs review user-uploaded images post-order, reducing IP risk.

keyFeatures.title: Seamless System Integration
keyFeatures.body: Maintained existing systems like Printess and HP Siteflow while adding new moderation capabilities.

keyFeatures.title: Enhanced Communication
keyFeatures.body: Automated email alerts for rejected uploads increase transparency and improve the user experience.
